title: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves

s.t: Ali Baba lived in a house with his wife.
s.fr: Ali Baba vivait dans une maison avec sa femme.

s.t: He was a poor woodcutter.
s.fr: Il était un pauvre bûcheron.

s.t: Every day, Ali Baba took his donkeys into the forest.
s.fr: Chaque jour, Ali Baba emmenait ses ânes dans la forêt.

s.t: He sold wood in the town.
s.fr: Il vendait du bois dans la ville.

paras.summary: Ali Baba is a poor woodcutter who lives with his wife, taking his donkeys into the forest every day to cut wood and sell it in the town.

s.t: Ali Baba's brother was Cassim.
s.fr: Le frère d’Ali Baba était Cassim.

s.t: Cassim was a rich merchant with many servants.
s.fr: Cassim était un riche marchand avec de nombreux serviteurs.

s.t: Cassim gave Ali Baba no money.
s.fr: Cassim ne donnait aucun argent à Ali Baba.

s.t: Ali Baba never asked his brother for money.
s.fr: Ali Baba ne demandait jamais d’argent à son frère.

s.t: He and his wife worked every day.
s.fr: Lui et sa femme travaillaient chaque jour.

paras.summary: Ali Baba's brother Cassim is a rich merchant with many servants, but he gives Ali Baba no money, so Ali Baba and his wife work every day instead of asking.

s.t: One morning, Ali Baba took his donkeys into the forest.
s.fr: Un matin, Ali Baba emmena ses ânes dans la forêt.

s.t: He walked into the trees to find wood.
s.fr: Il marcha entre les arbres pour trouver du bois.

s.t: He heard many horses coming near.
s.fr: Il entendit de nombreux chevaux s’approcher.

s.t: Ali Baba stopped his work and listened.
s.fr: Ali Baba arrêta son travail et écouta.

paras.summary: One morning Ali Baba takes his donkeys into the forest and walks among the trees to find wood, until he hears many horses coming near and stops to listen.

s.t: Ali Baba hid behind a tree.
s.fr: Ali Baba se cacha derrière un arbre.

s.t: His donkeys waited near the trees.
s.fr: Ses ânes attendirent près des arbres.

s.t: He saw many men ride out of the trees on horses.
s.fr: Il vit beaucoup d’hommes sortir des arbres à cheval.

s.t: Ali Baba counted the men and found there were 40 robbers.
s.fr: Ali Baba compta les hommes et trouva qu’il y avait 40 voleurs.

paras.summary: Ali Baba hides behind a tree and watches many men ride out on horses; he counts 40 of them and sees they are robbers.

s.t: The robbers stopped their horses before a great rock.
s.fr: Les voleurs arrêtèrent leurs chevaux devant un grand rocher.

s.t: The robber captain got down and walked to the rock.
s.fr: Le capitaine des voleurs descendit et marcha vers le rocher.

s.t: "Open Sesame!" said the robber captain.
s.fr: « Sésame, ouvre-toi ! » dit le capitaine des voleurs.

s.t: The great rock opened to show a dark cave inside.
s.fr: Le grand rocher s’ouvrit pour révéler une caverne sombre à l’intérieur.

s.t: Poor Ali Baba watched from behind his tree and was afraid.
s.fr: Le pauvre Ali Baba observait depuis derrière son arbre et avait peur.

paras.summary: The robbers stop before a great rock, and when the robber captain says "Open Sesame," the rock opens to show a dark cave, leaving Ali Baba afraid as he watches.

s.t: The 40 robbers went into the dark cave.
s.fr: Les 40 voleurs entrèrent dans la caverne sombre.

s.t: They stayed inside for some time.
s.fr: Ils restèrent à l’intérieur pendant quelque temps.

s.t: The robbers came out again.
s.fr: Les voleurs sortirent de nouveau.

s.t: The rock closed behind them.
s.fr: Le rocher se ferma derrière eux.

paras.summary: The 40 robbers go into the dark cave and stay inside for some time while Ali Baba stays behind his tree and watches, until the robbers come out again and the rock closes behind them.

s.t: The robber captain got back on his horse.
s.fr: Le capitaine des voleurs remonta sur son cheval.

s.t: The 40 robbers rode away into the forest.
s.fr: Les 40 voleurs s’éloignèrent à cheval dans la forêt.

s.t: Ali Baba came out from behind his tree.
s.fr: Ali Baba sortit de derrière son arbre.

paras.summary: The robber captain gets back on his horse, and the robbers ride away into the forest; Ali Baba comes out from hiding and walks to the rock.

s.t: Ali Baba took his donkeys back to the great rock.
s.fr: Ali Baba ramena ses ânes au grand rocher.

s.t: "Open Sesame!" said Ali Baba.
s.fr: « Ouvre-toi, Sésame ! » dit-il Ali Baba.

s.t: The rock opened, and Ali Baba went inside.
s.fr: Le rocher s’ouvrit, et Ali Baba entra à l’intérieur.

s.t: He saw a cave full of gold.
s.fr: Il vit une caverne pleine d’or.

s.t: Ali Baba had never seen so much gold.
s.fr: Ali Baba n’avait jamais vu autant d’or.

s.t: No robbers were in the cave.
s.fr: Il n’y avait aucun voleur dans la caverne.

paras.summary: Ali Baba takes his donkeys back to the great rock and says "Open Sesame," and the rock opens; inside, he finds a cave full of gold, more than he has ever seen, with no robbers there.

s.t: Ali Baba put some gold into sacks.
s.fr: Ali Baba mit de l’or dans des sacs.

s.t: He put the sacks on his donkeys.
s.fr: Il mit les sacs sur ses ânes.

s.t: He walked out, and the rock closed behind him.
s.fr: Il sortit, et le rocher se ferma derrière lui.

s.t: Ali Baba took his donkeys and the gold to his house.
s.fr: Ali Baba emmena ses ânes et l’or chez lui.

paras.summary: Ali Baba puts some of the gold into sacks, loads them onto his donkeys, and walks out as the rock closes behind him, taking his donkeys and the gold home.

s.t: Ali Baba's wife saw the gold.
s.fr: La femme d’Ali Baba vit l’or.

s.t: "Where did you find this gold?" she asked.
s.fr: « Où avez-vous trouvé cet or ? » demanda-t-elle.

s.t: Ali Baba told her of the robbers and the cave.
s.fr: Ali Baba lui parla des voleurs et de la caverne.

paras.summary: Ali Baba's wife sees the gold and says she has never seen so much money, so when she asks where he found it, Ali Baba tells her about the robbers and the cave.

s.t: Ali Baba's wife wanted to count the gold.
s.fr: La femme d’Ali Baba voulait compter l’or.

s.t: There was too much gold to count one by one.
s.fr: Il y avait trop d’or pour le compter un par un.

s.t: "I will borrow a cup from Cassim's wife," she said.
s.fr: « Je vais emprunter une tasse à la femme de Cassim », dit-elle.

s.t: She went to Cassim's house to ask for a cup.
s.fr: Elle alla chez Cassim pour demander une tasse.

paras.summary: Ali Baba's wife wants to count all the new gold, but there is too much to count one by one, so she decides to borrow a cup from Cassim's wife and goes to his house to ask.

s.t: Cassim's wife gave her a cup.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim lui donna une tasse.

s.t: But she wondered why a poor woodcutter's wife needed this cup.
s.fr: Mais elle se demandait pourquoi la femme d’un pauvre bûcheron avait besoin de cette tasse.

s.t: Cassim's wife put some fat in the bottom of the cup.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim mit un peu de graisse au fond de la tasse.

s.t: Ali Baba's wife counted the gold with the cup.
s.fr: La femme d’Ali Baba compta l’or avec la tasse.

paras.summary: Cassim's wife gives her the cup but wonders why a poor woodcutter's wife needs it, so she puts some fat in the bottom before Ali Baba's wife uses it to count the gold.

s.t: She gave the cup back to Cassim's wife.
s.fr: Elle rendit la tasse à la femme de Cassim.

s.t: Cassim's wife looked at the bottom of the cup.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim regarda le fond de la tasse.

s.t: A gold coin was stuck to the fat.
s.fr: Une pièce d’or était collée à la graisse.

paras.summary: Ali Baba's wife returns the cup, and when Cassim's wife looks at the bottom, she finds a gold coin stuck to the fat, showing that the cup was used for gold.

s.t: Cassim's wife showed Cassim the gold coin.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim montra la pièce d’or à Cassim.

s.t: "Your poor brother has gold?" said Cassim.
s.fr: « Ton pauvre frère a de l’or ? » dit Cassim.

s.t: Cassim was angry that Ali Baba had not told him.
s.fr: Cassim était en colère qu’Ali Baba ne lui ait pas dit.

s.t: "I will find out where this gold came from," said Cassim.
s.fr: « Je vais découvrir d’où vient cet or », dit Cassim.

paras.summary: Cassim's wife shows Cassim the coin, and when he learns his poor brother has gold, he grows angry that Ali Baba never told him and vows to find out where it came from.

s.t: Cassim went to Ali Baba's house.
s.fr: Cassim alla à la maison d’Ali Baba.

s.t: Cassim was rich, but he wanted more.
s.fr: Cassim était riche, mais il voulait plus.

s.t: "Where did you find this gold?" Cassim asked.
s.fr: « Où as-tu trouvé cet or ? » demanda Cassim.

s.t: Ali Baba did not want to tell his brother the secret.
s.fr: Ali Baba ne voulait pas dire le secret à son frère.

paras.summary: Cassim goes to Ali Baba's house, rich but wanting more, and asks where the gold came from, though Ali Baba does not want to tell his brother.

s.t: But Cassim was angry, and he stayed.
s.fr: Mais Cassim était en colère, et il resta.

s.t: "Tell me now!" said Cassim.
s.fr: « Dis-moi maintenant ! » dit Cassim.

s.t: He told Cassim about the robbers and the cave.
s.fr: Il raconta à Cassim l’histoire des voleurs et de la caverne.

s.t: "Open Sesame!" Ali Baba told him.
s.fr: « Sésame, ouvre-toi ! » lui dit Ali Baba.

s.t: These words would open the rock, he said.
s.fr: Ces mots ouvriraient le rocher, dit-il.

s.t: Ali Baba told Cassim not to forget the words.
s.fr: Ali Baba dit à Cassim de ne pas oublier les mots.

paras.summary: Cassim grows angry and stays, so Ali Baba, afraid, tells him about the robbers and the cave, reveals that the words "Open Sesame" open the rock, and warns him not to forget them.

s.t: Cassim listened to the words.
s.fr: Cassim écouta les mots.

s.t: "I will get much more gold than you did," said Cassim.
s.fr: « Je vais obtenir beaucoup plus d’or que toi, » dit Cassim.

s.t: The next morning, Cassim took 10 donkeys to the forest.
s.fr: Le lendemain matin, Cassim emmena 10 ânes dans la forêt.

paras.summary: Cassim listens to the words, wanting all the gold, and says he will get much more gold than Ali Baba did, so the next morning he takes 10 donkeys to the forest.

s.t: Cassim came to the rock with his donkeys.
s.fr: Cassim arriva au rocher avec ses ânes.

s.t: "Open Sesame!" said Cassim.
s.fr: « Sésame, ouvre-toi ! » dit Cassim.

s.t: The rock opened, Cassim went inside, and it closed behind him.
s.fr: Le rocher s’ouvrit, Cassim entra à l’intérieur, et il se referma derrière lui.

s.t: He saw the cave full of gold.
s.fr: Il vit la caverne pleine d’or.

s.t: Cassim took much more gold than Ali Baba did.
s.fr: Cassim prit beaucoup plus d’or qu’Ali Baba.

s.t: He filled sack after sack and put them on his donkeys.
s.fr: Il remplit sac après sac et les mit sur ses ânes.

paras.summary: Cassim comes to the rock with his donkeys, says "Open Sesame," goes inside, and loads much more gold than Ali Baba did, filling sack after sack onto his donkeys.

s.t: Cassim walked to the rock to leave.
s.fr: Cassim marcha vers le rocher pour partir.

s.t: But he had forgotten the words.
s.fr: Mais il avait oublié les mots.

s.t: "Open Wheat!" said Cassim.
s.fr: « Ouvre-toi Wheat ! » dit-il Cassim.

s.t: The rock did not open.
s.fr: Le rocher ne s’ouvrit pas.

s.t: "Open Barley!" said Cassim.
s.fr: « Ouvre-toi Barley ! » dit Cassim.

paras.summary: Cassim walks to the rock to leave but has forgotten the words, and neither "Open Wheat" nor "Open Barley" will make the rock open.

s.t: Cassim was alone and afraid, and he called for help.
s.fr: Cassim était seul et effrayé, et il appela à l’aide.

s.t: But no one came.
s.fr: Mais personne ne vint.

s.t: Then the robbers came back to the cave.
s.fr: Puis les voleurs revinrent à la caverne.

s.t: The rock opened, and the robbers found Cassim inside.
s.fr: Le rocher s’ouvrit, et les voleurs trouvèrent Cassim à l’intérieur.

s.t: The robbers killed Cassim to keep their secret.
s.fr: Les voleurs tuèrent Cassim pour garder leur secret.

paras.summary: Alone and afraid, Cassim calls for help, but no one comes until the robbers return, say "Open Sesame," and find Cassim inside; the robbers kill him to protect their secret.

s.t: Cassim did not come home that night.
s.fr: Cassim ne rentra pas chez lui ce soir-là.

s.t: Cassim's wife was afraid and went to Ali Baba.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim avait peur et alla voir Ali Baba.

s.t: "Cassim went to the forest and did not come back," she said.
s.fr: « Cassim est allé dans la forêt et n’est pas revenu, » dit-elle.

s.t: Ali Baba was afraid for his brother.
s.fr: Ali Baba avait peur pour son frère.

s.t: He took a donkey and went to find Cassim.
s.fr: Il prit un âne et alla chercher Cassim.

paras.summary: Cassim does not come home, so his wife, afraid, goes to Ali Baba and says Cassim went to the forest and never came back; Ali Baba, afraid for his brother, takes a donkey to find him.

s.t: Ali Baba came to the rock.
s.fr: Ali Baba arriva au rocher.

s.t: The rock opened, and Ali Baba went inside.
s.fr: Le rocher s’ouvrit, et Ali Baba entra à l’intérieur.

s.t: He found Cassim's body in the cave.
s.fr: Il trouva le corps de Cassim dans la caverne.

s.t: Ali Baba knew the robbers had killed Cassim.
s.fr: Ali Baba savait que les voleurs avaient tué Cassim.

paras.summary: Ali Baba comes to the rock, says "Open Sesame," goes inside, and finds Cassim's body in the cave, knowing at once that the robbers had killed him.

s.t: He put his brother's body on the donkey.
s.fr: Il mit le corps de son frère sur l’âne.

s.t: Ali Baba also took some gold for Cassim's wife.
s.fr: Ali Baba prit aussi de l’or pour la femme de Cassim.

s.t: Ali Baba waited until night to go home.
s.fr: Ali Baba attendit jusqu’à la nuit pour rentrer chez lui.

s.t: He brought the donkey home in the dark.
s.fr: Il ramena l’âne chez lui dans l’obscurité.

s.t: Cassim's wife cried when she saw her husband.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim pleura quand elle vit son mari.

s.t: No one in the town saw Ali Baba come home.
s.fr: Personne dans la ville ne vit Ali Baba rentrer chez lui.

paras.summary: Ali Baba puts his brother's body on the donkey, takes some gold for Cassim's wife, and walks out as the rock closes behind him, waiting until night to bring the donkey home in the dark; Cassim's wife cries when she sees her husband, and no one in the town sees Ali Baba come home.

s.t: Cassim's wife did not know what to do.
s.fr: La femme de Cassim ne savait pas quoi faire.

s.t: She was afraid that neighbors would ask why Cassim had died.
s.fr: Elle avait peur que les voisins demandent pourquoi Cassim était mort.

s.t: Cassim had a clever servant named Morgiana.
s.fr: Cassim avait une servante intelligente nommée Morgiana.

paras.summary: Cassim's wife does not know what to do, afraid neighbors will ask why Cassim died, but Cassim has a clever servant named Morgiana who knows how to keep the family safe.

s.t: She went to the neighbors and looked sad.
s.fr: Elle alla chez les voisins et parut triste.

s.t: "Cassim was ill, and now he has died," said Morgiana.
s.fr: « Cassim était malade, et maintenant il est mort, » dit-elle.

s.t: The neighbors were sad for the family.
s.fr: Les voisins étaient tristes pour la famille.

s.t: Cassim was buried, and no one asked why.
s.fr: Cassim fut enterré, et personne ne demanda pourquoi.

paras.summary: Morgiana goes to the neighbors, looking sad, and tells them Cassim was ill and has died; they are sad for the family, and Cassim is buried without anyone asking why.

s.t: Ali Baba wanted to help his brother's family.
s.fr: Ali Baba voulait aider la famille de son frère.

s.t: He took Cassim's wife and Morgiana into his house.
s.fr: Il prit la femme de Cassim et Morgiana dans sa maison.

s.t: Ali Baba gave Cassim's wife a home and money.
s.fr: Ali Baba donna à la femme de Cassim un foyer et de l’argent.

s.t: Morgiana was now a servant in Ali Baba's house.
s.fr: Morgiana était maintenant une servante dans la maison de Ali Baba.

s.t: Ali Baba was glad, for Morgiana was clever.
s.fr: Ali Baba était content, car Morgiana était intelligente.

s.t: The secret of the robbers and the cave stayed safe.
s.fr: Le secret des voleurs et de la caverne resta en sécurité.

paras.summary: Ali Baba wants to help his brother's family, so he takes Cassim's wife and Morgiana into his house, giving Cassim's wife a home and money; Morgiana is now his servant, and Ali Baba, glad she is so clever, keeps the secret of the robbers and the cave safe.

s.t: The robbers came back to the cave many times.
s.fr: Les voleurs revinrent à la caverne plusieurs fois.

s.t: One day, they saw that Cassim's body was gone.
s.fr: Un jour, ils virent que le corps de Cassim avait disparu.

s.t: "Someone knows our secret," said the robber captain.
s.fr: « Quelqu’un connaît notre secret, » dit-il, le capitaine des voleurs.

s.t: The robber captain was angry that someone knew their secret.
s.fr: Le capitaine des voleurs était en colère parce que quelqu’un connaissait leur secret.

paras.summary: The robbers return to the cave many times, and one day they see that Cassim's body is gone, so the robber captain says someone else knows their secret and grows angry.

s.t: He sent one robber into the town.
s.fr: Il envoya un voleur dans la ville.

s.t: "Find out who took the body," said the robber captain.
s.fr: « Découvrez qui a pris le corps, » dit le capitaine des voleurs.

s.t: This robber walked into the town.
s.fr: Ce voleur marcha dans la ville.

s.t: He heard that a rich merchant named Cassim had died.
s.fr: Il apprit qu’un riche marchand nommé Cassim était mort.

s.t: He heard that Cassim had a brother named Ali Baba.
s.fr: Il apprit que Cassim avait un frère nommé Ali Baba.

paras.summary: The robber captain sends one robber into the town to find out who took the body, and this robber listens to people, hearing that a rich merchant named Cassim has died and that Cassim has a brother named Ali Baba.

s.t: The robber found Ali Baba's house in the town.
s.fr: Le voleur trouva la maison d’Ali Baba dans la ville.

s.t: He had chalk with him.
s.fr: Il avait de la craie avec lui.

s.t: The robber marked Ali Baba's door with the chalk.
s.fr: Le voleur marqua la porte d’Ali Baba avec la craie.

s.t: "Now I know which house it is," he said.
s.fr: « Maintenant je sais quelle maison c’est, » dit-il.

s.t: The robber went back to the forest.
s.fr: Le voleur retourna dans la forêt.

paras.summary: The robber finds Ali Baba's house, marks the door with chalk he is carrying, says now he knows which house it is, and goes back to the forest.

s.t: The next morning, Morgiana went out into the town.
s.fr: Le lendemain matin, Morgiana sortit dans la ville.

s.t: She saw that someone had marked the door with chalk.
s.fr: Elle vit que quelqu’un avait marqué la porte avec de la craie.

s.t: Morgiana wondered why the door was marked.
s.fr: Morgiana se demanda pourquoi la porte était marquée.

s.t: No one in the house had marked the door.
s.fr: Personne dans la maison n’avait marqué la porte.

s.t: Morgiana took chalk.
s.fr: Morgiana prit de la craie.

s.t: She marked every other door on the street too.
s.fr: Elle marqua aussi chaque deuxième porte de la rue.

s.t: All the doors on the street looked the same.
s.fr: Toutes les portes de la rue avaient l’air identiques.

paras.summary: The next morning, Morgiana goes into the town and sees that someone has marked the door with chalk; she wonders why, since no one in the house had marked it, so she takes some chalk and marks every other door on the street too, until all the doors look the same.

s.t: That night, the robber led the others back to the street.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, le voleur ramena les autres dans la rue.

s.t: He looked for the door he had marked.
s.fr: Il chercha la porte qu’il avait marquée.

s.t: But every door looked the same.
s.fr: Mais chaque porte avait l’air identique.

s.t: "I cannot tell which house it is," said the robber.
s.fr: « Je ne peux pas dire quelle maison c’est, » dit-le voleur.

s.t: The robber captain was angry at him.
s.fr: Le capitaine des voleurs était en colère contre lui.

s.t: The robbers could not find the house, so they went back to the forest.
s.fr: Les voleurs ne purent pas trouver la maison, alors ils retournèrent dans la forêt.

paras.summary: That night, the robber leads the others back to the street, but he cannot find the door he marked since every door looks the same; the robber captain is angry at him, and the robbers go back to the forest without finding the house.

s.t: The robber captain went to see Ali Baba's house himself.
s.fr: Le capitaine des voleurs alla voir lui-même la maison d’Ali Baba.

s.t: The robber captain disguised himself as an oil merchant to get inside.
s.fr: Le capitaine des voleurs se déguisa en marchand d’huile pour entrer.

s.t: He hid 39 robbers in 39 jars.
s.fr: Il cacha 39 voleurs dans 39 jarres.

s.t: He filled one more jar with real oil.
s.fr: Il remplit une jarre de plus avec de la vraie huile.

paras.summary: The robber captain goes to see Ali Baba's house himself, then disguises himself as an oil merchant to get inside, hiding 39 robbers in 39 jars and filling one more jar with real oil.

s.t: The disguised captain had 40 jars on his donkeys.
s.fr: Le capitaine déguisé avait 40 jarres sur ses ânes.

s.t: He rode to Ali Baba's house with the jars.
s.fr: Il chevaucha jusqu’à la maison de Ali Baba avec les jarres.

s.t: "I am an oil merchant," the disguised captain said to Ali Baba.
s.fr: « Je suis un marchand d’huile, » dit le capitaine déguisé à Ali Baba.

s.t: "May I stay the night with my jars?" he asked.
s.fr: « Puis-je passer la nuit avec mes jarres ? » demanda-t-il.

paras.summary: The disguised captain has 40 jars on his donkeys, rides to Ali Baba's house, and asks to stay the night with his jars.

s.t: Ali Baba was kind to all guests.
s.fr: Ali Baba était aimable envers tous les invités.

s.t: "You may put your jars in my courtyard," said Ali Baba.
s.fr: « Vous pouvez mettre vos jarres dans ma cour, » dit Ali Baba.

s.t: "Stay and eat with us tonight," said Ali Baba.
s.fr: « Restez et mangez avec nous ce soir, » dit Ali Baba.

s.t: Ali Baba's son also welcomed the guest.
s.fr: Le fils d’Ali Baba accueillit aussi l’invité.

paras.summary: Ali Baba, kind to all guests, tells him to put the jars in the courtyard and stay for dinner, and Ali Baba's son also welcomes the guest.

s.t: He put his jars in the courtyard.
s.fr: Il mit ses jarres dans la cour.

s.t: He thanked Ali Baba and came in to eat.
s.fr: Il remercia Ali Baba et entra pour manger.

s.t: Morgiana cooked for the guest that night.
s.fr: Morgiana cuisina pour l’invité ce soir-là.

paras.summary: The disguised captain, glad, puts his jars in the courtyard, thanks Ali Baba, and comes in to eat while Morgiana cooks for the guest that night.

s.t: That night, Morgiana needed oil for the lamps.
s.fr: Ce soir-là, Morgiana avait besoin d’huile pour les lampes.

s.t: She went to the jars in the courtyard.
s.fr: Elle alla vers les jarres dans la cour.

s.t: Morgiana opened the first jar to get oil.
s.fr: Morgiana ouvrit la première jarre pour obtenir de l’huile.

s.t: A robber inside the jar whispered, "Is it time?"
s.fr: Un voleur caché dans la jarre chuchota, « Est-ce le bon moment ? »

s.t: Morgiana was afraid, but she stayed calm.
s.fr: Morgiana avait peur, mais elle resta calme.

s.t: "Not yet," she whispered back.
s.fr: « Pas encore, » chuchota-elle en retour.

paras.summary: That night, Morgiana needs oil for the lamps and goes to the jars in the courtyard, but when she opens the first jar, a robber inside whispers, "Is it time?"; she is afraid but stays calm, whispering back "Not yet," and realizes a robber is hidden inside the jar.

s.t: Morgiana checked the next jar.
s.fr: Morgiana vérifia la jarre suivante.

s.t: Another robber was hidden in that jar too.
s.fr: Un autre voleur était caché dans cette jarre aussi.

s.t: She checked every jar in the courtyard.
s.fr: Elle vérifia chaque jarre dans la cour.

s.t: A robber was hidden in each jar but one.
s.fr: Un voleur était caché dans chaque jarre sauf une.

s.t: The last jar held real oil.
s.fr: La dernière jarre contenait de la vraie huile.

paras.summary: She checks the next jar and finds another robber hidden inside, then checks every jar in the courtyard and finds a robber hidden in each one but the last, which holds real oil.

s.t: Morgiana took the oil and heated it until it boiled.
s.fr: Morgiana prit l’huile et la fit chauffer jusqu’à ce qu’elle bouille.

s.t: She poured the hot oil into each jar with a robber inside.
s.fr: Elle versa l’huile chaude dans chaque jarre avec un voleur à l’intérieur.

s.t: The hot oil killed the robbers in the jars.
s.fr: L’huile chaude tua les voleurs dans les jarres.

paras.summary: Morgiana heats the oil until it boils and pours it into each jar with a robber inside, and the hot oil kills the robbers in the jars, so she waits to see what will happen.

s.t: The disguised captain waited for his men to come out of the jars.
s.fr: Le capitaine déguisé attendit que ses hommes sortent des jarres.

s.t: He had told them to come out when he gave a signal.
s.fr: Il leur avait dit de sortir quand il donnerait un signal.

s.t: But no robber came out of any jar.
s.fr: Mais aucun voleur ne sortit d’aucune jarre.

s.t: The disguised captain went to the courtyard alone.
s.fr: Le capitaine déguisé alla dans la cour seul.

s.t: He looked inside the jars, one by one.
s.fr: Il regarda à l’intérieur des jarres, une par une.

s.t: He found his men dead in the jars.
s.fr: Il trouva ses hommes morts dans les jarres.

paras.summary: The disguised captain waits for his men to come out of the jars when he gives the signal, but no robber comes out, so he goes to the courtyard alone and finds his men dead in the jars.

s.t: The disguised captain was afraid.
s.fr: Le capitaine déguisé avait peur.

s.t: The disguised captain ran from the courtyard in the night.
s.fr: Le capitaine déguisé s’enfuit de la cour dans la nuit.

paras.summary: The disguised captain is afraid, knowing that someone had found his men, so he runs from the courtyard in the night and escapes alone, without any of his men.

s.t: In the morning, Ali Baba heard what Morgiana had done.
s.fr: Le matin, Ali Baba entendit ce que Morgiana avait fait.

s.t: Morgiana told Ali Baba about the oil merchant's jars.
s.fr: Morgiana raconta à Ali Baba les jarres du marchand d’huile.

s.t: "The jars were full of robbers, not oil," said Morgiana.
s.fr: « Les jarres étaient pleines de voleurs, pas d’huile, » dit Morgiana.

s.t: Ali Baba knew that Morgiana had saved his life.
s.fr: Ali Baba savait que Morgiana avait sauvé sa vie.

s.t: He was glad and thanked Morgiana.
s.fr: Il était content et remercia Morgiana.

paras.summary: In the morning, Ali Baba hears what Morgiana has done, and she tells him the oil merchant's jars were full of robbers, not oil; Ali Baba knows Morgiana has saved his life, and he is glad and thanks her.

s.t: The captain was now alone, for all his men were dead.
s.fr: Le capitaine était maintenant seul, car tous ses hommes étaient morts.

s.t: He wanted revenge.
s.fr: Il voulait se venger.

s.t: The captain disguised himself again, as another merchant.
s.fr: Le capitaine se déguisa de nouveau, en un autre marchand.

s.t: He went to the town and met Ali Baba's son.
s.fr: Il alla en ville et rencontra le fils d’Ali Baba.

s.t: The captain became friends with Ali Baba's son.
s.fr: Le capitaine devint ami avec le fils d’Ali Baba.

s.t: Ali Baba's son did not know who this merchant was.
s.fr: Le fils de Ali Baba ne savait pas qui était ce marchand.

paras.summary: The captain is now alone, for all his men are dead, and he wants revenge; he disguises himself again as another merchant, goes to the town, meets Ali Baba's son, and becomes his friend, though the son does not know who this merchant really is.

s.t: One day, Ali Baba's son asked the merchant to his home.
s.fr: Un jour, le fils de Ali Baba invita le marchand chez lui.

s.t: The captain came to Ali Baba's house as a guest.
s.fr: Le capitaine vint chez Ali Baba en tant que invité.

s.t: Ali Baba welcomed the guest.
s.fr: Ali Baba accueillit l’invité.

s.t: Morgiana looked at the guest.
s.fr: Morgiana regarda l’invité.

s.t: She recognized the captain, though he was disguised.
s.fr: Elle reconnut le capitaine, bien qu’il fût déguisé.

paras.summary: One day, Ali Baba's son asks the merchant to his home, and the captain comes to Ali Baba's house as a guest; Ali Baba welcomes him, but Morgiana looks hard at the guest and recognizes the captain, though he is disguised.

s.t: But Morgiana said nothing yet.
s.fr: Mais Morgiana ne dit rien encore.

s.t: Morgiana asked to dance for the guest with a dagger.
s.fr: Morgiana demanda à danser devant l’invité avec un poignard.

s.t: She danced before the captain with the dagger.
s.fr: Elle dansa devant le capitaine avec le poignard.

s.t: Then Morgiana killed the captain with the dagger.
s.fr: Puis Morgiana tua le capitaine avec le poignard.

paras.summary: Morgiana says nothing yet, but asks to dance for the guest with a dagger, and as she dances before the captain with the dagger, she kills him.

s.t: Ali Baba came and found the dead captain, with Morgiana and the dagger.
s.fr: Ali Baba arriva et trouva le capitaine mort, avec Morgiana et le poignard.

s.t: "You have saved my life again," said Ali Baba.
s.fr: « Tu as sauvé ma vie encore, » dit-il Ali Baba.

s.t: "The guest was the robber captain," said Morgiana.
s.fr: « L’invité était le capitaine des voleurs, » dit-elle, dit Morgiana.

s.t: Ali Baba knew that Morgiana had saved him twice.
s.fr: Ali Baba savait que Morgiana l’avait sauvé deux fois.

s.t: "You are no longer a servant," said Ali Baba.
s.fr: « Tu n’es plus une servante, » dit Ali Baba.

s.t: He gave Morgiana her freedom.
s.fr: Il donna à Morgiana sa liberté.

paras.summary: Ali Baba comes and finds the dead captain, with Morgiana and the dagger; she explains the guest was the robber captain, and Ali Baba, knowing she has now saved him twice, is glad she is so clever, tells her she is no longer a servant, and gives her freedom.

s.t: Ali Baba's son wanted Morgiana for his wife, and Ali Baba was glad.
s.fr: Le fils d’Ali Baba voulait Morgiana pour femme, et Ali Baba était content.

s.t: Ali Baba married Morgiana to his son.
s.fr: Ali Baba maria Morgiana à son fils.

s.t: They alone knew the secret of the cave.
s.fr: Eux seuls connaissaient le secret de la caverne.

s.t: The family used the gold wisely.
s.fr: La famille utilisa l’or sagement.

paras.summary: Ali Baba's son wants Morgiana for his wife, and Ali Baba, glad, marries her to his son; they alone know the secret of the cave, and the family uses the gold wisely.
